fields.summary: Helps Indian applicants choose between TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, and Duolingo, comparing score cutoffs, exam fees, and acceptance rates across US graduate departments.
Exam preparation strategies for Indian students targeting 100+ in TOEFL or 7.5 in IELTS, focusing on high speaking scores needed to qualify for funded Teaching Assistantships.
Profiles top US public R1 research universities for Indian families, highlighting institutions with competitive out-of-state tuition, generous research funding, and high return on investment.
Financial planning guide for Indian parents and students, breaking down the estimated $45,000 to $75,000 two-year budget required for tuition and living at public US universities.
Selection guide for Indian students evaluating US universities, using location, tuition brackets, public R1 research status, and assistantship funding availability to build a balanced shortlist.
Comprehensive overview of US visa regulations for Indian students, explaining work authorization transitions from initial F-1 status and CPT through OPT extensions and H-1B filings.
Step-by-step instructions for Indian graduates ordering the WES ICAP course-by-course evaluation ($217), detailing how to send verified university marksheets to World Education Services.
Explains how Indian 10-point CGPA and percentage grades are converted into the US 4.0 GPA scale by credential evaluators like WES for graduate admissions committees.
Demonstrates how Indian applicants with undergraduate CGPAs between 6.0 and 7.5 can strengthen their US master's profile using full-time software experience or published research papers.
